data.one_liner: Retrieves public IP address and country location using no-key third-party providers.
data.what_it_does: Retrieves a user's public IPv4 or IPv6 address and performs country and ISP lookups. It automatically falls back between multiple no-key third-party providers when services fail or time out.
use_when: You need to detect the user's country based on their public IP address.
You want automatic fallback between multiple free IP geolocation services.
avoid_when: You require absolute accuracy, as geolocation via public IP can be obscured by VPNs or proxies.
You need built-in caching for IP lookup results.
strengths: Automatic fallback between multiple public IP and location providers.
weaknesses: Results are not cached, so multiple calls trigger independent requests.
Depending on timeouts across failed services, lookups can take several seconds to complete.
Public IP geolocation is approximate and prone to interference from VPNs and mobile networks.
data.setup_notes: Android release builds require the INTERNET permission in AndroidManifest.xml.

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer making custom REST requests to a dedicated geolocation API instead of using a specialized package.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want to implement your own lightweight IP lookup logic using standard HTTP requests.
